scope: Universal Vulkan staged-buffer download correctness; no title or shader-hash conditions
upstream_change: Revert np-auth token commit caaa5419; eight np-auth/shadnet paths only. This is upstream maintenance, not an asserted graphics fix.
change: After actual copies into host staging, issue a buffer-scoped COPY/TRANSFER_WRITE -> HOST/HOST_READ barrier covering download.offset/download.size, with both queue families ignored. Apply to DownloadMemory and ReadEdgeImagePages before existing synchronous timeline wait or deferred completion callback. Retain cache invalidation, existing waits, dirty-range selection, write preservation, and metadata ownership.
causality_limit: A required GPU-to-host memory-domain dependency is absent in the inspected staged-copy paths. This does not prove that the omission caused GoW's RADV context loss, or that the new candidate restores gameplay.

validation.exact_methods: DownloadMemory and ReadEdgeImagePages extracted verbatim from old and patched production source; helper extracted from patched source
validation.local_cpu_model: GCC14 and Clang17 strict C++23 release builds passed baseline and corrected cases; corrected ASan+UBSan builds passed on both compilers. Eleven cases cover synchronous/deferred publication, allocation offsets, scattered copied spans, unchanged clean gaps, image edges, and empty fast path.
validation.baseline_observation: BASELINE_MISSING_HOST_DEPENDENCY=REPRODUCED in the CPU collaborator model; not a claim that stale GPU bytes were reproduced on hardware
validation.actual_vulkan_header_validation: PENDING on user host. Runner requires both baseline/corrected fixtures to compile against the project's actual Vulkan-Hpp headers before building the production object. Local Vulkan declaration collaborators are not presented as full native Vulkan validation.
validation.patch: Exact-preimage git apply --index, diff --check and reverse restore passed locally
validation.runner_safety: Real temporary Git repositories and patch/merge/ref operations passed compile-failure restore, successful-runtime restore, failed-runtime restore/nonzero exit, and dirty-source refusal. Native builds and game execution were stubbed in these four safety tests, not claimed run.

acceptance: Preserve previous exact candidate, PR94, PR91 and protected gameplay ELF. Run one bounded isolated GoW only after real-header fixture, production compile and link pass; retain resulting candidate separately and restore PR94. Archive full console and append local universal trials on failure or success. Do not promote as gameplay recovery without actual visible game evidence.
